NAMI Works

Brand System

The visual identity, in one page.

A quiet operator, not an AI-hype demo. Deep ink on warm off-white, one restrained teal accent, one characterful mascot. The mark carries the personality; type, palette, and copy stay restrained around it.

01 — The mark

A monkey in goggles

Monkey (primate, "natural") + goggles (augmentation, "artificial") — a soft nod to Natural + Artificial Merged Intelligence. Flavor, not a story that must be retold.

mark-black.png · on light
mark-accent.png · on light
mark-accent-dark.png · on dark

02 — Two assets, not one

Detailed mark vs. simplified glyph

The most common mistake to avoid: these are two different drawings, not one drawing at two sizes. The detailed mark's fine strokes collapse when tiny, so a separate bolder glyph exists for favicon and ≤24px contexts. The wired favicon.png is a copy of the simplified black glyph.

Detailed mark — mark-*.png

Use at ~32px and up: nav, headers, hero, print, avatars.

Simplified glyph — favicon-glyph*.png

Use tiny: favicon, app icon, ≤24px chips. Never as the large primary logo.

03 — Clear-space & minimum size

Give it room; know when to switch

Keep clear-space of at least 50% of the mark's height on every side. Detailed mark minimum is 24px — below that, switch to the glyph.

clear-space ≥ 50% of height

Minimum size

04 — Color

One warm neutral base, one teal accent

Tokens live in src/styles/global.css and are themed by [data-theme]. Reference the token, never the raw hex. No purple, no blue, no gradients — those belong to the sibling omnify-site.

05 — Typography

Geist, self-hosted

Geist variable (400–700) in one 29KB woff2, loaded via @font-face. -apple-system stays first so Apple devices get SF Pro; Geist is the near-match for everyone else. Headlines tight, body generous. Never reintroduce Inter; never load from a third-party CDN.

06 — Usage

Do & don't

Do

  • Match the mark tone to the theme: mark-accent on light, mark-accent-dark on dark.
  • Pair the mark with the wordmark in Geist 600, or let the mark stand alone.
  • Keep ≥50% clear-space and a solid backing on busy imagery.
  • Use the glyph below 24px.

Don't

  • Recolor outside the five approved files, or add shadows / gradients / "AI" glow.
  • Shrink the detailed mark to favicon size.
  • Stretch, rotate, or outline the mark.
  • Put copy or the mark over a product or another logo.
Source of truth: BRAND.md and the site source. This page is a rendered companion — if they disagree, fix the mismatch. Optimized nav-sized marks live in public/brand/optimized/.
